title: First-class ModelAttachment
root_cause: Model metadata, local artifacts, runtime details, hardware requirements, and fallback chains are not bound into one immutable attachment.
source_requirement: Add a validated ModelAttachment with exact model revision/hash and local GGUF/quantization/path where applicable.
implementation_steps: Bind runtime, context, modality, tools, privacy, benchmark revision, hardware, and fallback.
Hash exact local artifacts when applicable.
affected_tests: Model inventory and local runtime tests.
evidence_required: Local and remote attachment vectors with deterministic identity.
rollback: Remove attachment consumers and retain existing model inventory records.
acceptance_criteria: Every attachment names an exact immutable model identity.
Local artifacts bind path, quantization, and content hash.
